verses.text: For the one directing according to “A Dove of Distant Oaks.” Of David. A Miktam in the seizing of him [by] the Philistines in Gath. Show favor to me, O God, for man would swallow me up; all the day fighting, he oppresses me.

segments.text: For the one directing according to “A Dove of Distant Oaks.” Of David. A Miktam in the seizing of him [by] the Philistines in Gath. Show favor to me, O God, for man would swallow me up; all the day fighting, he oppresses me.

verses.text: My enemies swallow [me] up all the day, for many [are] fighting against me proudly.

segments.text: My enemies swallow [me] up all the day, for many [are] fighting against me proudly.

verses.text: [On] the day I am afraid, I will trust in You.

segments.text: [On] the day I am afraid, I will trust in You.

verses.text: In God—His word I praise—in God do I trust. I will not fear; what can flesh do to me?

segments.text: In God—His word I praise—in God do I trust. I will not fear; what can flesh do to me?

verses.text: All the day they wrest my words; their thoughts [are] all for evil against me.

segments.text: All the day they wrest my words; their thoughts [are] all for evil against me.

verses.text: They gather together, they hide, they mark my steps when they lie in wait for my soul.

segments.text: They gather together, they hide, they mark my steps when they lie in wait for my soul.

verses.text: Over iniquity bring [no] escape for them! In [your] anger, may You cast down the nations, O God!

segments.text: Over iniquity bring [no] escape for them! In [your] anger, may You cast down the nations, O God!

verses.text: My wanderings You have counted; put my tears in Your bottle—are [they] not in Your book?

segments.text: My wanderings You have counted; put my tears in Your bottle—are [they] not in Your book?

verses.text: Then my enemies will turn back on the day I cry out. This I have known, that God [is] for me.

segments.text: Then my enemies will turn back on the day I cry out. This I have known, that God [is] for me.

verses.text: In God whose word I do praise, in YHWH whose word I praise—

segments.text: In God whose word I do praise, in YHWH whose word I praise—

verses.text: in God I have put my trust! I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

segments.text: in God I have put my trust! I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

verses.text: Your vows, O God, [are] upon me; I will give thank offerings to You.

segments.text: Your vows, O God, [are] upon me; I will give thank offerings to You.

verses.text: For You have delivered my soul from death, [Do You] not keep my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living!
